implementation.name: original-v1-data-selection-resnet-data-path
implementation.scope: Same four stages and source full-epoch reference. A four-record toy trace retains A and C. The materialized coreset exists before the epoch; its construction cost is outside this replay. The default stream alternative follows the figure caption: all A–D are read, decoded, and copied before B/D are rejected from accelerator training arithmetic. Earlier metadata filtering is a separate possible design. No wall-clock speedup is inferred.
implementation.question: Where does a discarded image stop costing work?

purpose: Where does a discarded image stop costing work?

storyboard.label: Compare selection policies
storyboard.description: Both policies train on A and C. The distinction is where rejected records stop moving.

storyboard.label: Read materialized coreset
storyboard.description: Storage supplies A and C only. B and D are absent from this materialized training dataset.

storyboard.label: Decode the coreset
storyboard.description: The host decodes and augments A and C.

storyboard.label: Transfer coreset tensors
storyboard.description: PCIe copies A and C tensors; storage and host records remain distinct representations.

storyboard.label: Train on coreset
storyboard.description: The accelerator computes on A and C. This trace does not model throughput.

storyboard.label: Start stream-and-discard alternative
storyboard.description: Reset the alternative: the full source still contains A, B, C, and D.

storyboard.label: Read full source
storyboard.description: Stream filtering cannot avoid reading rejected records from storage.

storyboard.label: Decode the full stream
storyboard.description: The host decodes and augments A, B, C, and D. This default trace follows the original figure’s accelerator-work-only stream comparison.

storyboard.label: Copy the full tensor stream
storyboard.description: A, B, C, and D tensor copies cross PCIe before selection in this declared late-filter case. Earlier filtering can save downstream traffic, but is a different placement.

storyboard.label: Reject B and D before training arithmetic
storyboard.description: B and D branch to rejection after their storage, decoding, and transfer work has occurred. A and C remain eligible for accelerator training.

storyboard.label: Train on the same retained A and C
storyboard.description: The accelerator computes training arithmetic only for A and C. This late stream case saves arithmetic while preserving upstream storage, host, and PCIe work.

guard: Follow original caption default: stream filtering saves training arithmetic only; full read/decode/transfer costs already occurred. Materialization construction/scoring excluded from replay, never claimed free.
